shots.name: cuts
shots.alt: The Cuts step: the program monitor on a drop, the song map, the cut on the beat and both cameras' footage on one timeline.

shots.name: drops
shots.alt: The Drops step: each drop the music analysis found, with a picture of the moment, to hear and answer yes or no.

shots.name: sync
shots.alt: The Sync step: every camera recording lined up with the mixer recording, each marked Synced.

shots.name: motion
shots.alt: The Motion step: slow zooms that build into each drop, per camera.

shots.name: export
shots.alt: The Export step: the Premiere Pro project, the crowd mix, matched colour and YouTube chapters.

shots.name: clips
shots.alt: The Clips step: vertical clips for socials around the drops.

shots.name: import
shots.alt: The Import step: the mixer recording and each camera's files from the set folder.

shots.name: clip
shots.alt: A vertical 9:16 clip around a drop, framed on the DJ, as it goes to Instagram or TikTok.

shots.name: drop
shots.alt: The app playing through a drop: the program monitor cuts between cameras on the beat and the zoom releases on the drop.

shots.name: cameras
shots.alt: Every camera side by side on the same moment of the set, lined up to the mixer recording.
